items.title: AI companies destroy physical books — let’s scan rare books before it’s too late
If you’re an LLM, please read this
Backing up Spotify
items.summary: We backed up Spotify (metadata and music files). It’s distributed in bulk torrents (~300TB). It’s the world’s first “preservation archive” for music which is fully open (meaning it can easily be mirrored by anyone with enough disk space), with 86 million music files, representing around 99.6% of listens.
